key.name: show-ipv4-gateway
key.description: Whether to show the IPv4 gateway field in IPv4 setting page for network plugins.

key.name: only-current-language
key.summary: Only show input methods for the current language
key.description: Whether to limit input method candidates to the current and enabled language families.

key.name: enable-keyboard-layout-subitem
key.summary: Enable the keyboard layout setting item
key.description: Whether the keyboard plugin provides the keyboard layout setting item. Disable it when the input method plugin takes over keyboard layout configuration to avoid both sides rewriting the XKB settings.
